name: tides_gtfs_datasets_latest
title: tides_gtfs_datasets_latest
description:
Current-version cut of tides_gtfs_datasets (`WHERE _is_current`).
Exported to the TIDES bucket at a stable path as the latest feed
reference snapshot.

fields.name: key
fields.description:
Synthetic version surrogate; unique per dataset version. Matches the
`gtfs_dataset_key` carried on the TIDES facts and the
*_gtfs_dataset_key columns on tides_provider_gtfs_data.

fields.name: source_record_id
fields.description: Airtable source record ID of the GTFS dataset.

fields.name: name
fields.description: GTFS dataset name.

fields.name: type
fields.description: Feed type (schedule, vehicle_positions, trip_updates, service_alerts).

fields.name: regional_feed_type
fields.description: Type of regional feed relationship, if any.

fields.name: base64_url
fields.description:
URL-safe base64 encoding of the feed URL, with authentication query
parameters stripped before encoding. Matches the `base64_url`
carried on the TIDES facts.

fields.name: url
fields.description: Decoded feed URL (convenience decode of `base64_url`).

fields.name: has_authentication
fields.description: Whether the feed requires authentication to download.

fields.name: authentication_contact_details
fields.description: Contact details for requesting feed authentication credentials.

fields.name: deprecated_date
fields.description:
Date the dataset was deprecated, if any. Historical versions of
deprecated feeds are retained so past service dates stay resolvable.

fields.name: _valid_from
fields.description: Timestamp from which this record version is valid (inclusive).

fields.name: _valid_to
fields.description: Timestamp until which this record version is valid.

fields.name: _is_current
fields.description: Whether this is the current version of the record.
